offline_compatibility.method: Render current shared contract plus each Bixby50 response with embedded package Jinja under enable_thinking=false, once with string contents and once with Android-style [{type:text,text:...}], and compare with GenUiTrainedConverter simple adapter bytes.

expected_prompt_token_counts.method: 1 + SentencePiece.encode(rendered_prompt after literal <bos>); metadata start_token id=2. Raw SentencePiece does not emit control id=2 from literal <bos>.

reuse_assessment.GenUiTrainedConverter: Text-only serialization is byte-faithful for all 50 under thinking=false, but unchanged reuse mislabels this artifact as trained_e2b_v10_w4, pins the old model identity, and unnecessarily overrides the richer embedded template. Use embedded template for the new profile.
reuse_assessment.GenUiTrainedBixby50Test: Case subset selection and deterministic no-MTP settings are reusable, but unchanged harness defaults/profile/provenance are v10-W4-specific.
reuse_assessment.OfficialMobileNativeQualityProbeTest: Preferred when supplied external requests are built from this shared contract and independently rendered by the embedded template; require full-history runtime render equality before generation.
reuse_assessment.primary_benchmark: BXP-001,BXP-003,BXP-009; MTP disabled. Any MTP-on run is exploratory and must be labeled outside the faithful current-workflow benchmark.

provenance_limits: The package has no embedded current-run shared-prompt snapshot, prepared manifest, training config, checkpoint receipt, or source commit binding.
The LiteRT header timestamp/UUID and preserved official sections do not prove when or how the target weights were trained/exported.

Current-contract reconstruction and byte-parity show the appropriate checkout/runtime contract, but do not prove this exact supplied artifact was trained with that contract without its external run directory/sidecars.
Drafter presence does not prove task-specific training, acceptance, quality, or speed; current workflow says it is official preserved bytes and runtime-disabled.
